findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Observed floor behind prep table in kitchen to be soiled with food debris. Clean and sanitize floor behind prep table.

6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: In-use utensils: properly stored
findings.citation_text: 3-304.12  (C) In-Use Utensils are stored incorrectly at the salad bar. Observed children to use tongs and then throw them back into the food so that the cut peppers and broccoli are contaminated by the handles. Store in-use utensils: 1) in the food with the handle above the top of the food item; 2) on a clean and sanitized surface; 3) in running water; 4) in a container of hot water maintained at or above 135 °F. Reference 3-304.12. Suggest providing holders for the tongs or develop some system of use so that the food is not contaminated. The kindergarden class is throwing the tongs in to the food. They may be too young to serve themselves.

findings.title: Utensils, equipment & linens: properly stored, dried, & handled
findings.comment: 4-903.11(A), (B) and (D)  (C) Clean Equipment/Utensils/Linens/Single-Use Articles stored incorrectly. Observed plates on the cart to be stored with the food contact surface exposed. Children were putting their hands on plates that were not their own on the food contact surface. Equipment, Utensils, Linens and Single-Use Articles shall be stored: 1) in a clean and dry location; 2) away or protected from contamination; 3) at least six inches above the floor; 4) covered or inverted. Reference 4-903.11(A), (B) and (D). Invert plates, instruct children to only take the top plate, and touch only the plate they are going to eat from.

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used
findings.citation_text: 4-202.11  (Pf) Food-Contact surface of the measuring cup for popcorn oil is no longer smooth and easily cleansable. A food-contact surface that is not smooth and easily cleansable can harbor bacteria that con be transfer to food. Replace with a National Sanitation Foundation/ANSI approved surface. Reference 4-202.11.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.citation_text: 4-602.13  (C) Soil residue present on the floor under the sink at baseboard heaters. Baseboard heaters are also soiled. Two different types of cockroaches are observed on the glue board in this area. Clean all non-food contact surfaces frequently to prevent soil accumulation.  Reference 4-602.13.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment: The nylon cutting boards are observed to have scores on the edges and be rough as to no longer be easily cleansable.  Replace cutting boards as needed or repair by sanding or planing to make the surfaces smooth again. 750-650a Food contact surfaces shall be smooth, non absorbent, easily cleansable, and free of breaks, open seams, cracks, chips, pits, and free of difficult-to-clean internal corners and crevices.

findings.title: Original container, properly labeled, consumer advisory
findings.comment: No time tags observed on cooling foods in the reach in cooler. 750-140b Potentially hazardous food shall be labeled or tagged with date and time of preparation and rapidly cooled to an internal temperature of 41°F. Provide proper labeling on cooling foods.  Ensure that the foods reach 70F by 12 o'clock pm.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.citation_text:
750.690 - Plastic covering is loose on the shelf beneath the electrical box in the kitchen. Repair the shelf so the covering is not loose.

Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.citation_text:
750.1060 - Handsink had low water pressure during inspection. Repair the handsink so it has more water pressure.

All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.citation_text:
750.1200 & 1220 - A) Floor tiles under freezer are loose and starting to pull up in a couple spots. Repair or replace the tiles - the end result needs to be smooth, cleanable, and easily maintained in a sanitary condition.

B) Floor behind the grease trap was soiled with general debris. Clean the floor behind the grease trap.

Floors must be in good repair, constructed to facilitate easy cleaning, and maintained clean.

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.citation_text:
750.120 - White milks in a crate located at the front right corner inside the milk cooler by kitchen entrance were not at proper temperature. Surface temperatures were observed at 49F-54F. Internal temperatures for three cartons were at 46F, 53F, and 52F. Milks in other locations in the same cooler had much lower surface temperatures. The crate of white milk in the front right corner was removed for disposal; ~32 cartons total (see general comments)

Cold potentially hazardous foods shall be maintained at proper cold holding temperature of 41F/below during storage.
